images.prompt: Create an original natural color food photograph of exactly three ripe peaches in one shallow matte white ceramic bowl on a pale stone tabletop. Two peaches sit toward the front and one behind, each visibly separate with natural pink-yellow skin and fine fuzz. One clear straight-sided drinking glass half-filled with water stands at upper right outside the bowl, leaving a visible gap. Soft daylight from upper left, normal photographic illumination without dramatic water reflections, gentle contact shadows, plain pale wall in the background. Three-quarter view from slightly above, entire bowl and glass visible, no cut fruit, leaves, utensils, hands or additional dishes. Vertical 4:5 image, exactly 1024x1280 pixels. Realistic source photograph, full coherent composition, no lettering, brands, watermark, frame or stylized effects.
